title: Information-Theoretic Scaling Laws for Generative Diffusion Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.33337v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models trained on increasingly large datasets sampled from the same data distribution will converge to the same learned distribution. However, in practice, a model trained on finite data depends on the particular training dataset; this dependence is reflected in properties of the model's outputs, such as memorization and sample quality. To understand this dependence through an information-theoretic lens, we study \textit{model information}, a computationally tractable measure of how much samples from the trained model depend on the particular training dataset. We explore its scaling behavior as model size and training dataset size vary. translated_title: 生成式扩散训练的信息论缩放定律
translated_abstract: 在从同一数据分布采样的规模不断增大的数据集上训练的扩散模型，会收敛到相同的习得分布。然而在实践中，用有限数据训练的模型依赖于特定的训练数据集；这种依赖性体现在模型输出的各种性质中，例如记忆化（memorization）和样本质量。为了通过信息论的视角理解这种依赖性，我们研究了“模型信息”，这是一种在计算上可处理的度量，用于衡量训练模型的样本对特定训练数据集的依赖程度。我们探讨了该度量随模型规模和训练数据集规模变化时的缩放行为。具体而言，我们揭示了两种性质上截然不同的缩放区域：(1) 非线性模型信息区域，标志着从纯记忆化到不完美泛化的过渡；(2) 泛化区域，其特征是模型信息呈线性缩放，并伴随逐渐改善的样本质量。
tldr: 本文提出“模型信息”这一可计算的信息论度量来量化训练后的扩散模型对特定训练数据集的依赖程度，并揭示了其随模型与数据规模变化而呈现的两个缩放区域——从纯记忆化过渡到不完美泛化的非线性区域，以及以线性缩放为特征的泛化区域。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "model information," a computationally tractable information-theoretic measure of how much a trained diffusion model depends on its specific training dataset, and reveals two distinct scaling regimes as model and dataset sizes vary: a nonlinear regime marking the transition from memorization to imperfect generalization, and a generalization regime characterized by linear scaling.
